meta.description: Half-sarcomere geometric specification (Z-disc center -> M-line). Source of truth for the renderer.

components.name: Z-disc
components.biological_role: Anchors thin filaments and titin N-termini; sarcomere boundary

repeating_geometry.lattice: square in Z-disc, transitions to hexagonal in A-band

components.evidence_class: MEASURED (dimensions); render shape SCHEMATIC — see evidence_by_claim
components.notes: Z-disc width is species- and muscle-dependent (30–62 nm); 50 nm is a declared skeletal-context working value, not construct identity.

components.name: Thin filament (actin-tropomyosin-troponin)
components.biological_role: Interacts with myosin cross-bridges; carries regulatory proteins

attachment_points.pointed_end: toward M-line, free tip in I/A overlap

repeating_geometry.lattice_positions: trigonal points of hexagonal thick-filament lattice

components.state_dependence: length invariant; overlap with thick changes with SL
components.evidence_class: MEASURED (dimensions); render shape SCHEMATIC — see evidence_by_claim
components.notes: Skeletal thin filament ~1.0-1.3 um; using 1.05 um.

components.name: Thick filament (myosin + titin A-band)
components.biological_role: Myosin motor filament; scaffolds titin A-band and provides cross-bridges
relationships: myosin H periodicity, crown spacing, L periodicity, and titin sequence intervals are stored as distinct quantities

myosin_head_H_periodicity_nm.preparation: demembranated rabbit-psoas fibers at 35 C with 5% Dextran

thick_filament_L_periodicity_nm.preparation: demembranated rabbit-psoas fibers at 35 C with 5% Dextran
thick_filament_L_periodicity_nm.not_claimed: the exact molecular length of an 11-domain titin repeat

components.state_dependence: A-band width constant; only overlap changes
components.evidence_class: MEASURED (dimensions); render shape SCHEMATIC — see evidence_by_claim
components.notes: Caremani 2021 reports distinct H (~43.1 nm), crown (~14.3 nm), and axial L (~45.5 nm) quantities; none is stored as an exact titin molecular repeat length.

components.name: M-band center
components.biological_role: Cross-links thick filaments at their centers; anchors titin C-termini

dimensions_nm.axial_extent: UNKNOWN in the retained model; no M-band width is adopted
dimensions_nm.lateral_extent_YZ: crosslink relationships only; exact extent unresolved

components.orientation: coordinate plane normal to X; crosslink orientations unresolved
relationships: coincident with the midpoint of the thick-filament head-free bare zone; the interval itself belongs to the thick filament

repeating_geometry.myomesin_family_context: sparse crosslink relationships; exact register unresolved

components.mechanical_behavior: central integration/anchoring region; compliance is not modelled
components.evidence_class: STRONGLY INFERRED (midpoint and component relationships); render shape SCHEMATIC — see evidence_by_claim
components.notes: The 160 nm interval belongs to the thick-filament bare zone. This record supplies the sarcomere midpoint and M-band integration relationships only; it adopts no M1 density or M-band width.

components.name: Transverse myofilament lattice
components.biological_role: Hexagonal packing of thick/thin filaments; sets interfilament spacing
relationships: thick at hex vertices, thin at trigonal points

repeating_geometry.verified: reproduces Desmos calculator: d10=34.99, d_MA=23.33, d_y=20.20 at SL=2.85um

components.mechanical_behavior: spacing decreases as SL increases (constant-volume first-order)
components.state_dependence: d10(SL) per scaling law; REAL muscle Poisson ratio time-varying (not strictly isovolumetric)
components.evidence_class: MODELED (absolute dimensions and scaling); render shape SCHEMATIC — see evidence_by_claim
components.notes: The stored 4.03e6 nm3 cell-volume parameter reproduces the referenced calculator and is MODELED, not an absolute value adopted from Irving 2000. Irving independently measures the direction and preparation dependence of d10(SL). The constant-volume law is a labelled quasi-static idealization; do NOT present it as exact instantaneous contraction behavior (Cass 2021).

copy_number.note: ~6 titin molecules per half-thick-filament is retained as contextual evidence; the SC-20 public representative path does not encode this copy number.
copy_number.public_render_policy: one representative molecule; copy number and azimuth are not encoded

unknowns.item: Azimuthal arrangement of the 6 titin molecules around the thick filament
unknowns.reason: Resolved by 6 A cryo-EM of the human cardiac thick-filament C-zone (PDB 8G4L, doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06691-4). Measured from the deposited coordinates: the six strands are NOT equally spaced on one radius. They form three 120 deg sectors, each carrying a TA/TB pair 30 deg apart, TA at r=8.57 nm and TB at r=6.85 nm. The 120 deg sector repeat is exact only because 3-fold symmetry was IMPOSED during reconstruction.
unknowns.modeling_directive: For the tissue-neutral reference-sequence public render named by scientific_scope.json, show one representative molecule and encode neither copy number nor azimuth. Preserve the measured cardiac C-zone two-shell sector arrangement in data/context_measurements.json as context, not as a silent transfer. A future cardiac mode may use it as MEASURED only in the C-zone; other tissue or D-zone use would remain INFERRED and must be explicitly selected.

superseded.previous_reason: Six-fold symmetry inferred; exact angular positions not resolved.
